title: OpenJutsu character swap (HyperFlow H3 Flash)
description: Swap the person in a clip for the character in one picture. The scene, the camera, the performance and the clip's own sound stay. Runs HyperFlow H3 Flash on this computer; one clip of 5 to 15 seconds with the person in its first frame. A clip where the person leaves the frame stops with a message.

controls.label: Direction
controls.default: Replace the selected person in <Video 1> with the character in <Picture 1>. Use the complete character from <Picture 1>, preserving its distinctive shape, proportions, features, limbs and clothing without cutting them off. Ignore the background, setting and light of <Picture 1>. Keep everything else of <Video 1> unchanged: background, framing, aspect ratio, other people, camera, light, performance and audio timing.
